# SmartScope

> > Technical documentation and guides for AI coding agents, focusing on Claude Code, MCP integration, and practical implementation patterns for developers.

SmartScope provides in-depth technical resources for implementing AI agent systems, with comprehensive coverage of Claude Code, Model Context Protocol (MCP), GitHub Copilot integration, and enterprise-grade guardrails. The site specializes in practical implementation guides, performance optimization, and security best practices for production AI development environments.

## Key Topics

- Claude Code
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Claude Sonnet 4
- AI Agent Implementation
- GitHub Copilot Integration
- Security Guardrails
- Performance Optimization
- ChatGPT Agents
- Sub-Agent Architecture
- Docker DevContainer
- Python & TypeScript Development
- Troubleshooting & Error Handling
- Business Automation
- Agent Skills Framework
- Production Environment Best Practices
